[[File:Reward casket (medium) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (medium)''' is received after completing the final clue of a [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's possession.

==Rewards==
Medium clues generate a minimum of 3 rewards and a maximum of 5, granting an average of 4 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, shared treasure trail items and items that are unique for medium clues. Additionally, players have a 1/30 chance to receive a [[master clue scroll]] upon opening a medium casket. On average, it will take 2076 reward caskets to obtain all the unique drops specific to medium clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers).

All droprates are confirmed by [[Mod Tide]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1131933683714330624|date=24 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106558|archivedate=24 May 2019|quote=I know its been a while since the clue expansion but here is the information on clue scroll drop rates and loot chances! If anything changes I will keep you posted.|name=Clue rates tweet}}{{CiteGeneral|url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16pVNHdZyynmxIbM9mynRDYT0LQsWxq-vbDs4_7DpnGM/edit?usp=sharing|title=Clue scrolls 2019|author=|time=24 May 2019}} The listed rarities are per roll.

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|{{#expr:floor({{MediumClueValue}})}}}}, for an average value per casket of {{Coins|{{#expr:floor(4 * {{MediumClueValue}})}}}}. The 1/30 chance of receiving a master clue scroll adds another {{Coins|{{#expr:floor(1/30 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}}))}}}}, for a total expected value per clue of {{Coins|{{#expr:floor(4 * {{MediumClueValue}} + 1/30 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}}))}}}}.

However, these averages are heavily skewed by the extremely high value of [[ranger boots]] compared to the rest of possible rewards. When they are removed from consideration, the average loot roll drops to {{Coins|{{#expr:floor({{MediumClueValue}} - ({{GEP|Ranger boots}} * 1/11 * 1/103))}}}}, and the average medium clue drops to {{Coins|{{#expr:floor(4 * ({{MediumClueValue}} - ({{GEP|Ranger boots}} * 1/11 * 1/103)))}}}} when not factoring master clues.

* The droprate for any medium clue unique (excluding those in the Mega-Rare Table) is 1/10 per reward roll.

==Rewards on Entrana==
Caskets opened on [[Entrana]] will not reward unique items, weapons, or armour.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1276268920270393348|date=25 Jun 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104301|archivedate=9 Dec 2020|quote=It rolls the table without such items being included, yeah. That also includes most equipable items, even items without stats such as Bob shirts. But it's a useful place to go if you want prayerbook pages.}} This makes the remaining items roughly twice as common.

The average medium casket opened on Entrana is worth {{Coins|4*{{Average drop value|mob=Reward casket (medium)#Entrana|raw=yes}}}}, not including master clue rewards (see {{Section|Rewards}}).

==Trivia==
*[[Yew comp bow]]s used to be as common a reward as [[yew shortbow]]s, while players were not able to receive [[yew longbows]] as a reward at all. However after a [[Update:Barbarian Assault Ranged Rework|game update]] on [[25 January]] [[2018]], players started reporting yew longbows as a new common reward from their medium clue scrolls. Since then, yew comp bows also seem to be rarer to get as a reward. No changes to the Treasure Trails rewards table were mentioned in the official update post.
*Along with the [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)|Treasure Trail expansion]] on [[6 July]] [[2016]], the Ancient, Armadyl and Bandos [[Vestment robes|vestment sets]] were completed with mitres, cloaks, stoles and croziers. These items were added as a reward for medium clue scrolls, even though Saradomin, Zamorak and Guthix stoles and croziers are rewards of hard clue scrolls.
*With the [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion|Treasure Trail expansion]] on [[12 June]] [[2014]] update, 43 new unique rewards were added to medium clue scrolls. Two weeks later, [[Holy sandals]] were added in a [[26 June]] [[2014]] [[Update:Midsummer Event|update]]. The [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)|Treasure Trail expansion]] on [[6 July]] [[2016]] added another 12 unique rewards to medium clue scrolls.
*Mod Mat K revealed in a 2016 data stream{{CiteVideo|title=Old School RuneScape Data Session with Mod Mat K!|author=Old School RuneScape
|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-5hXaHEzIM&t=465s|site=YouTube|timestamp=7:45}} that on average 7,000 medium clue scrolls were completed every day.
